params.prompt: Graphic novel inked illustration, painted tableau, a frozen moment. In a desert camp at dusk under a blood-red sky, a bitten man kneels in the sand clutching his bleeding foot beside a coiled red serpent; a cloaked man with a hand extended toward the serpent stands nearby, with several distant robed figures fixed among tents and red cliffs behind. The camera performs a slow push-in toward the serpent and the wounded foot. Nothing moves -- every figure, the serpent, and the tents stay fixed as drawn. No invented motion, no morphing, no new elements, no camera shake. Painted tableau stays still; only the camera moves.
